title: New Zealand Earthship built from 1,300 tyres and 7,000 bottles goes on sale after TV fame
summary_full: For sale in New Zealand's scenic Coromandel region, a distinct four-bedroom Earthship home composed of recycled tyres and glass bottles awaits new owners. This eco-conscious abode, featuring solar power and passive heating, was constructed in 2015 and has gained popularity following its showcase on Grand Designs New Zealand. Owners Gus Anning and Sarah Rowe are transitioning to the Bay of Islands, seeking individuals who will honor their sustainable dream.
